verdict.rationale: Honeybadger is a SaaS error-tracking platform that ingests customer application data, so it is a fair question whether it lets users opt out of AI-model training on that data. The axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or privacy commitment. The security doc covers request tokens and the MCP docs cover AI assistant access, neither of which addresses training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
